name: binary_fuse16_filter_contains
description: Tests if a Binary Fuse 16-bit filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: binary_fuse16_filter
description: Creates a Binary Fuse 16-bit filter (~0.0015% false positive rate) by aggregating values of any type: UBIGINT values are used as keys as they are, other values are hashed with XXH64 of a fixed encoding that does not change between DuckDB versions. Returns a BLOB to probe with binary_fuse16_filter_contains.

name: quotient_filter
description: Creates a Quotient filter sized to fit its input: q is chosen so that the distinct values fill at most 3/4 of the 2^q slots. r is the number of remainder bits (false positive rate ~2^-r). Values are handled as by quotient_filter(q, r, value).

name: xor16_filter_info
returnType: STRUCT(filter_type VARCHAR, format_version UTINYINT, key_hash VARCHAR, key_type VARCHAR, size_bytes UBIGINT, entries UBIGINT, capacity UBIGINT, load_factor DOUBLE, fingerprint_bits UTINYINT, bits_per_entry DOUBLE, expected_fpr DOUBLE, q UTINYINT, r UTINYINT, seed UBIGINT)
description: Describes a xor16_filter BLOB: filter_type, format_version (0 for a BLOB without header), key_hash (none or xxhash64), key_type, size_bytes, entries, capacity, load_factor, fingerprint_bits, bits_per_entry, expected_fpr, q, r and seed; fields a filter type does not have are NULL.

name: binary_fuse8_filter
description: Creates a Binary Fuse 8-bit filter (~0.4% false positive rate) by aggregating values of any type: UBIGINT values are used as keys as they are, other values are hashed with XXH64 of a fixed encoding that does not change between DuckDB versions. Returns a BLOB to probe with binary_fuse8_filter_contains.

name: bloom_filter
description: Creates a split block Bloom filter (the Parquet Bloom filter format) sized for ndv distinct values at a false positive rate of fpp. Values are hashed with XXH64 of their Parquet plain encoding, so the filter matches the Bloom filters Parquet writers produce. Bloom filters of the same size merge with bloom_filter_merge. Returns a BLOB to probe with bloom_filter_contains.

name: bitfilter_is_valid
description: Returns whether a BLOB is a structurally valid bitfilters filter with a header.

name: quotient_filter_is_valid
description: Returns whether a BLOB is a structurally valid quotient_filter, instead of raising the error quotient_filter_contains would.

name: bitfilters_duckdb_hash
description: Computes the DuckDB-internal hash value for the given DuckDB version. The hash matches DuckDB's built-in hash() function for that version. Multiple values are combined using the version's CombineHash algorithm. Supported versions: v1.4.0-v1.4.4, v1.5.0, v1.5.1, v1.6.0, v2.0.

examples.code: SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', col1, col2) FROM tbl;

name: bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create
description: Creates a DuckDB-compatible bloom filter by aggregating pre-hashed UBIGINT values. Use bitfilters_duckdb_hash() to hash values first. The version and num_sectors (power of 2) are constants. Returns a BLOB that can be probed with bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe.

name: binary_fuse16_filter_is_valid
description: Returns whether a BLOB is a structurally valid binary_fuse16_filter, instead of raising the error binary_fuse16_filter_contains would.

name: quotient_filter
description: Creates a Quotient filter from values of any type: UBIGINT values are used as keys as they are, other values are hashed with XXH64 of a fixed encoding that does not change between DuckDB versions. q is the number of quotient bits (the filter holds at most 2^q - 1 values) and r the number of remainder bits (false positive rate ~2^-r). q + r must be <= 64. Returns a BLOB to probe with quotient_filter_contains.

name: bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe
description: Probes a DuckDB-internal bloom filter (serialized as BLOB) for a value. The version parameter specifies which DuckDB hash algorithm to use. The version must be constant; a constant filter blob is parsed once at bind time, otherwise (e.g. a scalar subquery or a BLOB column) it is read per row. A NULL filter returns NULL. Multiple value arguments are combined for multi-key bloom filter probes.

examples.code: SELECT key_col, bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe('v2.0', (SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create('v2.0', 1024, bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', k)) FROM range(100) t(k)), key_col) AS maybe_present FROM range(98, 102) t(key_col);

WITH f AS (SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create('v2.0', 1024, bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', i, 'k' || i)) AS filter_blob FROM range(100) t(i)) SELECT col1, col2, bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe('v2.0', (SELECT filter_blob FROM f), col1, col2) AS maybe_present FROM (VALUES (1::BIGINT, 'k1'), (1, 'k2'), (200, 'k200')) t(col1, col2);

name: bitfilter_contains
description: Tests if any bitfilters filter may contain a value; the filter's header says what kind of filter it is and how its values were hashed. Returns true if the value might be in the set, or false if it is definitely not.

returnType: STRUCT(filter_type VARCHAR, format_version UTINYINT, key_hash VARCHAR, key_type VARCHAR, size_bytes UBIGINT, entries UBIGINT, capacity UBIGINT, load_factor DOUBLE, fingerprint_bits UTINYINT, bits_per_entry DOUBLE, expected_fpr DOUBLE, q UTINYINT, r UTINYINT, seed UBIGINT)
description: Describes any bitfilters filter BLOB: filter_type, format_version (0 for a BLOB without header), key_hash (none or xxhash64), key_type, size_bytes, entries, capacity, load_factor, fingerprint_bits, bits_per_entry, expected_fpr, q, r and seed; fields a filter type does not have are NULL.

name: bloom_filter_merge
description: Merges Bloom filters (BLOBs produced by bloom_filter with the same ndv and fpp) into one filter containing every value of the inputs.

name: xor16_filter
description: Creates an Xor16 filter (16-bit fingerprints, ~0.0015% false positive rate) from a column of any type: UBIGINT values are used as keys as they are, other values are hashed with XXH64 of a fixed encoding that does not change between DuckDB versions. Returns a BLOB to probe with xor16_filter_contains.

name: bloom_filter_info
returnType: STRUCT(filter_type VARCHAR, format_version UTINYINT, key_hash VARCHAR, key_type VARCHAR, size_bytes UBIGINT, entries UBIGINT, capacity UBIGINT, load_factor DOUBLE, fingerprint_bits UTINYINT, bits_per_entry DOUBLE, expected_fpr DOUBLE, q UTINYINT, r UTINYINT, seed UBIGINT)
description: Describes a bloom_filter BLOB: filter_type, format_version (0 for a BLOB without header), key_hash (none or xxhash64), key_type, size_bytes, entries, capacity, load_factor, fingerprint_bits, bits_per_entry, expected_fpr, q, r and seed; fields a filter type does not have are NULL.

name: quotient_filter
description: Merges Quotient filters (BLOBs produced by quotient_filter) into a single filter containing every value of the inputs. q and r size the merged filter, which holds at most 2^q - 1 values. Each input must keep at least q + r bits of each hash (its own q + r must be >= q + r), so a merge can grow q only by giving up as many remainder bits. The inputs must be built from the same type of values. q + r must be <= 64.

name: xor16_filter_is_valid
description: Returns whether a BLOB is a structurally valid xor16_filter, instead of raising the error xor16_filter_contains would.
